nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address controlling changeOwner via onlyOwner modifier.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner staged before acceptOwnership promotes it.
ERC20.symbol token ticker, set once in the HotShib constructor.
ERC20.name token name, set once in the HotShib constructor.
ERC20.decimals used as the base-10 exponent for supply computation.
ERC20.totalSupply initial circulating amount minted to the owner.
ERC20.balances mapping of holder balances; mutated by unchecked +/- arithmetic.
ERC20.allowed nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount.
HotShib.maxSupply hard cap mirroring totalSupply, set in the constructor.
Owned.changeOwner: onlyOwner-guarded staging of a new owner address.
Owned.acceptOwnership: two-step ownership acceptance gated on msg.sender == newOwner.
ERC20.balanceOf: read-only balance lookup.
ERC20.transfer: moves balances using unchecked subtraction and addition.
ERC20.transferFrom: spends allowance and moves balances with unchecked arithmetic.
ERC20.approve: writes the caller's allowance for a spender.
ERC20.allowance: read-only allowance lookup.
HotShib constructor: mints supply, sets metadata, owner and balances.
HotShib.receive: external payable fallback that unconditionally reverts.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller address used for auth and balance indexing.
balances[msg.sender] -= _amount in transfer, unchecked uint256 subtraction.
balances[_to] += _amount credit, unchecked uint256 addition in transfer/transferFrom.
balances[_from] -= _amount in transferFrom, unchecked uint256 subtraction.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount in transferFrom, unchecked subtraction.
1000000000000*10**uint256(decimals) supply math compiled without overflow checks.
owner = newOwner privileged state write performed inside acceptOwnership.
Parameter _newOwner of Owned.changeOwner.
Parameter _owner of ERC20.balanceOf.
Parameter _to of ERC20.transfer, the credited account.
Parameter _amount of ERC20.transfer.
Parameter _from of ERC20.transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter _to of ERC20.transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter _amount of ERC20.transferFrom.
Parameter _spender of ERC20.approve.
Parameter _amount of ERC20.approve.
Parameter _owner of ERC20.allowance.
Parameter _spender of ERC20.allowance.
Parameter _owner of the HotShib constructor.
Return local 'success' of ERC20.transfer.
Return local 'success' of ERC20.transferFrom.
Return local 'success' of ERC20.approve.
Return local 'balance' of ERC20.balanceOf.
Return local 'remaining' of ERC20.allowance.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier gates changeOwner on the caller-controlled msg.sender == owner check.
acceptOwnership only proceeds when msg.sender equals the staged newOwner.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
Staged newOwner is promoted into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership writes the owner state variable.
msg.sender determines whether the privileged owner = newOwner write executes.
acceptOwnership performs the owner assignment, changing protocol privileges.
transfer executes the unchecked subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _amount.
_amount flows into the unchecked balance subtraction.
msg.sender indexes the caller balance that is debited.
balances mapping is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
transfer executes the unchecked addition balances[_to] += _amount.
_to indexes the destination balance being credited.
_amount is added into balances[_to].
transferFrom credits balances[_to] using the same unchecked addition pattern.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction balances[_from] -= _amount.
_from indexes the debited balance account.
_amount is subtracted from balances[_from] without overflow checks.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction of allowed[_from][msg.sender].
_amount is subtracted from the stored allowance.
msg.sender indexes the nested allowance mapping.
allowed mapping is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
_spender keys the allowance mapping entry.
_amount is stored as the allowance value.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
allowance reads allowed[_owner].
allowance reads allowed[_spender].
constructor computes the supply with an unchecked exponentiation and multiplication.
constructor initializes totalSupply.
constructor initializes maxSupply.
constructor sets the decimals scale used for supply math.
constructor credits balances[owner] with the entire total supply.
constructor assigns the privileged owner role from the _owner parameter.
msg.sender keys the balances mapping in transfer and balanceOf.
msg.sender keys the allowed mapping in approve and transferFrom.
transfer returns the success flag.
transferFrom returns the success flag.
approve returns the success flag.
balanceOf returns the queried balance.
allowance returns the remaining allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner only exists as the input that changeOwner stores into newOwner.
_owner is only an index argument for the balanceOf lookup.
_to is the destination index consumed by the transfer credit operation.
_amount is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction in transfer.
_from is the source index consumed by the transferFrom debit.
_to is the destination index consumed by the transferFrom credit.
_amount is the operand of the unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
_spender is only a mapping key for the approve write.
_amount is only the value written by approve.
_owner is only a read key for the allowance lookup.
_spender is only a read key for the allowance lookup.
_owner is the argument that the constructor turns into the privileged owner.
success is the trivial boolean return value of transfer.
success is the trivial boolean return value of transferFrom.
success is the trivial boolean return value of approve.
balance is the trivial return value of the balanceOf view function.
remaining is the trivial return value of the allowance view function.
